component.name: 云听
component.summary: 网易云音乐的非官方 Linux 客户端

description.p: A NetEase Cloud Music client for Linux with a native KDE/Qt interface. It puts your personal recommendations first and supports MPRIS media keys and the system tray.
为 Linux 打造的网易云音乐客户端：原生 KDE/Qt 界面，个人推荐优先， 支持 MPRIS 媒体键与系统托盘。

ul.li: Daily recommendations, personal FM, heart mode and charts
每日推荐、私人漫游、心动模式与排行榜
Line-by-line scrolling lyrics, desktop lyrics and comments
逐行滚动的歌词、桌面歌词与评论区
Listen together with friends, and download songs to play offline
和好友一起听，下载歌曲离线播放
QR code sign-in; likes, playlists and collections stay in sync with your phone
扫码登录，红心、歌单与收藏和手机同步

description.p: Yunting is developed by the community. It is not an official NetEase Cloud Music application and is not affiliated with NetEase.
云听由社区开发，不是网易云音乐的官方应用，与网易公司没有关联。

screenshot.caption: Recommendations: daily picks, heart mode, personal radio and playlists
推荐：每日推荐、心动模式、私人漫游与推荐歌单
A chart with audio quality badges
榜单与音质标记
Dark colors that follow the system
跟随系统的深色配色

description.p: The daily recommendations page can show past days: a row of dates above the tracks (today and the recent days NetEase keeps, for black vinyl VIP members) switches the list to that day. A client left running now refetches the daily recommendations after the 6:00 rollover.
每日推荐页可以看历史日推：曲目上方一排日期（今天和网易保留的最近几次，黑胶 VIP 才有），点一下换成那一天的歌。客户端一直开着时，过了 6:00 会自己换成新一天的推荐。
The window background now uses the same colours as the title bar, so the title bar and the page read as one surface without a seam.
窗口底色与标题栏同色，标题栏和页面连成一片，不再有接缝。

With Breeze's plain grey colours, the app now uses a Material You scheme generated from your accent colour and follows changes live; when a kde-material-you-colors scheme or another tinted scheme is active, the app follows the system. Login keeps the QR code and adds "Sign in with a cookie" for when scanning is not possible. The whole window uses the View colour set, so secondary text is easier to read, and the equalizer runs on a single thread.
系统是 Breeze 默认的中性灰时，应用改用按强调色生成的 Material You 配色，并随系统改动实时变化；正在用 kde-material-you-colors 或其他有色调的方案时原样跟随系统。登录保留扫码，扫不了时可以用 Cookie 登录。整个窗口改用 View 配色组，次要文字更清楚；均衡器改为单线程。

The equalizer, bass boost and stereo width work again (they had been broken since 0.6.21): mpv's lavfi filter has no threads option, and passing it made the whole af chain fail to parse. The parameter is gone; filter-graph threading cannot be limited in mpv 0.41. The builtin Lua scripts are now really disabled: load-scripts only matters before mpv initialization, so the remaining load-select/load-positioning/load-commands/load-context-menu options are set as well (thread count during playback: 53 → 27).
均衡器、低音增强与声场宽度恢复（0.6.21 起失效）：lavfi 没有 threads 选项，写上会让整条 af 解析失败。内置 Lua 脚本真正停掉了：load-scripts 在 mpv 初始化后无效，补上 select/positioning/commands/context-menu 的开关（播放线程数 53 → 27）。

Signing in now lets you pick the QR session to use: the PC client session (type=3, as SPlayer) or the web session (type=1, as YesPlayMusic). Both kinds of MUSIC_U are accepted by the API. The cookie-paste box from 0.6.22 is gone: scanning already yields that web cookie, so choosing the right session is all that is needed.
登录可以选扫码会话了：客户端（type=3，与 SPlayer 相同的 PC 客户端会话）或网页（type=1，与 YesPlayMusic 相同的网页会话），两种 MUSIC_U 接口都认。0.6.22 的 Cookie 粘贴框移除——扫码拿到的本来就是这份网页 Cookie。

Cookies from the web player can now be used to sign in: below the QR code, "Sign in with a cookie" accepts a pasted cookie header or just the MUSIC_U value, and validates it with the server before keeping it.
可以用网页端的 Cookie 登录了：扫码框下方的「用 Cookie 登录」接受粘贴的整段 Cookie 或 MUSIC_U 的值，提交前先向服务器校验，无效的 Cookie 不留在本地。另外修复了搜索框的清除按钮会把输入内容换成热搜词并立刻搜索的问题。

Memory use is noticeably lower: mpv stream buffers no longer default to 150 MiB (32 MiB for songs, 64 MiB for MVs, 4 MiB for voice comments), the builtin Lua scripts of all three players are off (about 12 fewer threads), the equalizer filter runs on a single thread, the allocator is limited to four arenas, and freed pages return to the system when an MV closes.
内存占用明显下降：mpv 的流缓冲不再用默认的 150 MiB 上限（歌 32 MiB、MV 64 MiB、语音评论 4 MiB），三个播放器都关掉内置 Lua 脚本（少约 12 个线程），均衡器滤镜只开一个线程，分配器限制在 4 个内存池，MV 关闭时把碎片页还给系统。

Playback works again after the computer wakes from sleep: music pauses before sleep, the audio output is rebuilt after waking, and a song stopped halfway reloads from the same position. Pressing play after a song failed to load now fetches a fresh address instead of doing nothing.
电脑睡眠唤醒后又能放歌了：睡前暂停，醒来重建音频输出，停在歌中间的从原位置重新载入。一首歌没放成后再按播放会重新取址，不再没反应。

Voice comments can be played: a capsule under the comment shows the clip's length and progress, with the server's transcript beside it. The song pauses while a clip plays and resumes afterwards, except in a listen together room.
语音评论可以播放了：评论下面的胶囊显示语音长短和播放进度，旁边是语音转文字。放语音时歌先暂停，放完接着放；一起听的房间里歌不暂停。

Scroll bars take the Breeze shape: an 8 px rounded handle that stays visible while the content overflows and turns the accent colour on hover, still without a groove or separator line. Icon buttons such as like and share no longer look doubled at fractional scales like 1.15.
滚动条改成 Breeze 原生的样子：8 像素宽的圆角把手，内容超出时一直显示，悬停时变成强调色，仍然没有滚动槽和分隔竖线。喜欢、分享等图标按钮在 1.15 这类小数缩放下不再有重影。
Scroll bars are a single rounded handle: no groove and no separator line beside lists. They appear while scrolling, fade out afterwards, and widen on hover.
滚动条只剩一条圆角把手，列表旁不再有滚动槽和分隔竖线；滚动时出现，停下后淡出，悬停时变宽。

Upload songs to your cloud and import playlists from a song list or other platforms' links. Make your own playlists private and give them up to three tags. Hug and copy comments, and forward events; your own events can change visibility or be deleted. Listen together no longer skips two songs when one change arrives twice.
可以把本机的歌上传到云盘，用歌曲清单或其他平台的链接导入歌单；自己的歌单可设为私密、加最多 3 个标签。评论可以抱一抱、复制，动态可以转发，自己的动态可以改可见范围或删除。一起听不再因为同一次切歌收到两条命令而连跳两首。

Listen together keeps both sides in sync again, invites a friend with one click, shows how often you have listened together and marks songs your friend cannot play. Private messages can be sent, and cards and listen-together invites in them can be opened. Chinese and Japanese use one font, also in the Flatpak, and multi-line Chinese text gets more line spacing.
一起听双方重新保持同步，点好友即可邀请，显示你们一起听过多少，并标出对方放不了的歌。私信可以发送，里面的卡片和一起听邀请可以点开。中日文使用同一款字体（Flatpak 版也一样），中文多行正文的行距加大。

After switching songs, changing audio quality or seeking, the progress bar and lyrics no longer jump back for a moment. The Flatpak uses system portals to keep the computer awake and to store your login; if you signed in to an earlier Flatpak build, sign in once more.
切歌、换音质或拖动进度后，进度条和歌词不再短暂跳回。Flatpak 版改用系统门户来防止睡眠和保存登录信息；以前用 Flatpak 版登录过的，需要重新登录一次。

The listen-together button on the player bar now opens a panel that lists your mutual follows: friends who are listening together or online come first, the rest show when you last listened together. The app icon follows the colour scheme, so it is light on a dark theme. Rows in the Similar pane are spaced like every other list.
点播放条上的「一起听」，弹出的面板会列出互相关注的好友：正在一起听的、在线的排在前面，其余显示上次和你一起听的时间。应用图标随配色变化，暗色主题下是浅色图标。「相似」栏的歌曲行间距与其他列表一致。

The "Last month" listening-rank tab no longer stays on "Loading...". Switching tabs now requests the selected range, and a late response for the previous tab cannot overwrite it. Tile titles containing a line break stay on one line.
「最近一月」听歌排行不再一直显示「正在取回」；切换周/月会请求当前选择，旧标签页的迟到回包不会覆盖新数据。标题里带换行的磁贴标题保持单行。
Avatar pendants that fail to load are retried with a fresh cache-busting URL, so a transient image failure no longer hides the pendant until the app restarts.
头像挂件加载失败时会用新的缓存破坏地址重试，不再因为一次临时失败就藏到重启应用为止。

Your own avatar pendant in the header and on user pages; user pages show anyone's worn pendant without waiting for it. The SVIP badge is a quiet tint of the accent colour, and comments, wiki and similar run down to the progress line.
页头和用户主页显示自己的头像挂件，别人主页戴着的挂件也显示，且不再拖慢主页；SVIP 标改为主题色的淡渐变；评论、百科、相似一直铺到进度线。

A "Similar" pane on the now-playing page; avatar pendants and distinct VIP / SVIP badges; the suggested search keyword. "Open in client" from the browser works even when the desktop portal has no display, and launching again returns to the open window at once.
正在播放页多了「相似」一栏；显示头像挂件，VIP 与 SVIP 分得出；搜索框显示推荐词。浏览器里的「在客户端打开」在门户没有图形环境时也能打开，再次启动立刻回到已开的窗口。

NetEase links open in the app: "open in client" on the web, links passed on the command line, and links copied in other apps (including phone short links), after asking. Albums and logged-out playlists can be shared, long descriptions open in full, and launching again returns to the open window.
网易云的链接在云听里打开：网页上的「在客户端打开」、命令行里的链接、在别的程序里复制的链接（含手机分享的短链，先问一句）。专辑与未登录时的歌单可以分享，长简介可以展开，再次启动回到已经打开的窗口。
The now-playing cover sits on the page with a thin contact shadow instead of floating above it.
正在播放页的封面改为贴着页面的薄阴影，像放在桌上，不再浮起来。
Comments on playlists can be liked; the now-playing cover gets a soft shadow and rounded corners; downloads keep the song's duration and a second click no longer downloads a song twice.
歌单评论也能点赞；正在播放页的封面有了柔和的投影和圆角；下载的歌记下时长，取地址时再点一次不会重复下载。
